svg.text: One origin: how a request is routed
Every client (phone, glasses, kiosk screen, Pi) hits the same Worker. apps/worker/src/index.ts decides where it goes.
rider app; /k/:car is the NFC landing; /m is a game seat
/g/?ride = ride HUD, /g/ = games on the lens
which flow and version are live
email code, guest, profile, add an email, delete
check in, move car, Not now, arrived, ghost, end
stamps, recent matches, report, block, unblock
409 if not riding; snapshot after rider.hello
screen or pi; 4002 when the trip changes
every error body is an ErrorRes
Static first: a request for a real file is served from
the assets binding before any route runs. A path with no
extension that 404s gets its prefix's SPA shell, so
client routes like /k/1412 and /passport/map work on reload.
No CORS: every client is same-origin; the Vite dev
